name: Bol
summary: Sync stock and orders with bol. Automatic order import, stock updates and shipping labels.
tagline: Manage all your bol stores in one place.
about: Bol is the largest online marketplace in the Netherlands and Belgium. Alongside its own range, bol also offers a platform where external sellers, known as partners, can list their products. Customers order easily through the website or app, and delivery is handled by bol or the partners themselves.

faqs.q: Are paused products imported into ShopLinkr?
faqs.a: Yes, all products in your bol environment are imported into ShopLinkr. Is a product paused? Then in ShopLinkr you will see that the product is marked as "inactive". You can easily reactivate the product from within ShopLinkr and take it off pause right away.

faqs.q: Can I process Fulfilment by bol (VVB) orders in ShopLinkr?
faqs.a: Yes. If you use Fulfilment by bol (Verzenden via bol), you process those orders in ShopLinkr just the same. You use the labels bol provides and keep all your shipments in one overview.

faqs.q: Can I connect multiple bol accounts to ShopLinkr?
faqs.a: Yes. You connect each bol account as a separate sales channel via Settings > Sales channels, so you manage all your bol stores in one place.

faqs.q: What happens to my stock when I connect bol?
faqs.a: When you connect, your bol stock is adjusted to the stock in ShopLinkr, provided the product already exists there. From that moment on, ShopLinkr is the only place where you need to adjust your stock.

faqs.q: Are new bol orders imported automatically?
faqs.a: Yes, new bol orders come into ShopLinkr automatically, so you can process them all in one place.
